description: This file defines a custom validation annotation named `LocalDate` used within the Fineract project. It specifies validation constraints for date-related fields, including properties like message, dateField, formatField, and localeField, and references an external validator class `LocalDateValidator`.

classes.name: LocalDate
classes.description: A custom validation annotation for local date validation, specifying fields and parameters for date validation constraints.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Defines the default error message key for validation failures.

methods.name: dateField
methods.description: Specifies the name of the field containing the date to validate.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Specifies the name of the field indicating the date format.

methods.name: localeField
methods.description: Specifies the name of the field indicating the locale.

methods.description: Validation groups the annotation belongs to.

methods.description: Additional payloads associated with the validation annotation.
